etoro_intro_body: Porty brings in your eToro positions and keeps them up to date, so you don't have to add them by hand.
etoro_point_read_only_body: Porty can see your portfolio, nothing else. It can't buy, sell or change anything in your account.
etoro_point_sync_body: When you open Porty or pull down on Home, we bring in the latest from eToro.
etoro_point_disconnect_body: From here or from eToro. When you disconnect, we delete the access from our servers.
etoro_connect_footnote: You'll sign in to eToro, not to Porty. We never see your password.
etoro_connected_body: Your eToro positions update on their own. In Porty they carry the eToro mark and can't be edited.
etoro_reconnect_body: eToro closed Porty's access (this happens when the session expires or if you revoked it from eToro). Your positions are still here with the data from {when}, but they aren't updating.
etoro_disconnect_body: Porty will no longer have access to your account. What should we do with the {count} imported positions?
etoro_disconnect_body_generic: Porty will no longer have access to your account. What should we do with what was imported?
etoro_disconnect_keep_body: You'll be able to edit and close them, but they won't update from eToro anymore.
etoro_disconnect_delete_body: They leave Porty. Your eToro account doesn't change.
etoro_detail_partial_note: Some purchases update from eToro. The ones you added by hand are closed from here.
etoro_result_none_title: We didn't find positions to import
etoro_result_pending_body: We're bringing in your eToro positions.
etoro_result_subtitle: Your eToro portfolio is now in Porty and updates on its own.
etoro_result_subtitle_closed: Plus {count} sales for your history. Everything updates on its own.
etoro_result_sync_failed: The first import didn't go through. We'll try again on our own the next time you open Porty.
etoro_result_duplicates_body: These were also added by hand. If they're the same purchases, delete the manual ones so they don't count twice.
etoro_result_duplicates_row: In eToro and also added by hand
etoro_result_closed_not_imported_title: Sales we didn't add to your history
etoro_skip_cfd: They're contracts for difference: you don't own the asset. Porty shows what belongs to you.
etoro_skip_leveraged: With leverage, the risk and the result can't be shown properly in Porty.
etoro_skip_short: They gain when the price falls. Porty doesn't show them yet.
etoro_skip_copy_trading: Someone else or eToro manages them. We don't show them for now.
etoro_skip_non_us: For now Porty prices stocks and ETFs from US exchanges.
etoro_skip_unknown_instrument: We couldn't identify the asset reliably, so we didn't guess.
etoro_error_write_scope: eToro gave Porty permission to trade. For your safety we didn't accept it and saved nothing. Try again and allow read-only access.
etoro_error_missing_scope: eToro didn't give Porty permission to see your portfolio. Try again and accept read access.
etoro_error_expired: The connection took too long. Try again.
etoro_error_unavailable: The eToro connection isn't available right now. Try again later.
etoro_error_busy: It's already updating. Wait a few seconds.
etoro_error_connect: We couldn't connect your account. Try again.
etoro_error_rate_limited: eToro asked us to wait a bit. Try again in a minute.
etoro_error_sync_unavailable: eToro isn't responding right now. Your positions keep the data from the last update.
etoro_error_plan: Connecting eToro is included in Premium and Gold.
etoro_error_sync: We couldn't update from eToro. Try again.

plan_feature_allocation_plan: Portfolio plan: how much you want of each holding and how to split each contribution
allocation_settings_subtitle: How much you want of each holding
allocation_intro_porty: I'll help you build your portfolio plan: how much you want of each investment.
allocation_intro_body: Over time, what goes up ends up weighing more and what goes down, less. With a plan, I'll let you know when your portfolio drifts from what you want and tell you where to put each contribution to get back.
allocation_locked_body: The portfolio plan is a Premium feature: you decide how much you want of each investment, I let you know when you drift and tell you where to put each contribution to get back.
allocation_intro_step1_title: Choose what you want to hold
allocation_intro_step1_body: We start with what you already have. You can remove things or add others.
allocation_intro_step2_body: Move one bar and I'll adjust the rest: it always adds up to 100%.
allocation_intro_step3_body: How much room you allow and how often you want me to check.
allocation_disclaimer: It's your plan: Porty only does the math. This is not investment advice.
allocation_error_load_body: Check your connection and try again.
allocation_wizard_leave_body: The changes to your plan will be lost.
allocation_pick_porty: First, what do you want in your portfolio? I checked what you already have: uncheck what you don't want in your plan and add what you'd like to start buying.
allocation_pick_porty_empty: First, what do you want in your portfolio? Add the investments that will make up your plan.
allocation_pick_left_out: {tickers}: you still hold it, but it counts as 0% in your plan. If it keeps weighing a lot, I'll flag it.
allocation_split_porty: Now, how much of each? Move the bars and I'll adjust the rest so it always adds up to 100%.
allocation_split_porty_single: With a single investment, it's 100% of your plan. To split it, go back and add another one.
allocation_split_insight_concentrated: {ticker} is {pct}% of the plan: whatever happens to it will weigh heavily on your whole portfolio.
allocation_split_insight_spread: None is more than a third of the plan: it's spread out.
allocation_split_zero: At 0%: it won't be in your plan
allocation_split_lock_hint: Tap the lock to fix a percentage: when you move the others, it won't change.
allocation_edit_body: I'll adjust the rest so it still adds up to 100%.
allocation_alerts_porty: Last, when do you want me to alert you?
allocation_alerts_porty_note: What goes up ends up weighing more than you planned, and what goes down, less. If something drifts beyond the margin you choose, I'll let you know so you can decide whether to get back to your plan.
allocation_margin_title: How much room do you allow?
allocation_margin_body: These are points of difference between today's weight and your plan. For example, with 5 points, something that's 40% in your plan is fine between 35% and 45%.
allocation_margin_tight: Tight: I'll alert you on small changes
allocation_bands_title: With this margin, in your plan:

allocation_notify_body: If you turn it off, you'll still see it on your home screen.
allocation_frequency_weekly_body: Mondays at 10 a.m., only if something went past the margin.
allocation_frequency_monthly_body: The first Monday of each month at 10 a.m., only if something went past the margin.
allocation_review_porty: Done! This is your plan. If it looks right, save it.

allocation_alert_summary_monthly: I'll alert you on the first Monday of each month if something drifts more than {points} points from your plan.

binance_intro_body: Bring your crypto from Binance and keep it up to date automatically. Read-only: Porty never trades, withdraws or moves your funds.
binance_steps_title: How to create a read-only key
binance_step_1: In Binance, go to your profile → API Management.
binance_step_2: Create a new key (system generated) and name it, for example "Porty".
binance_step_3: Leave only "Enable Reading" on. Don't enable trading, withdrawals or transfers: if you do, Porty rejects the key.
binance_step_4: Copy the key and the secret and paste them below.
binance_privacy: We store the key encrypted on our server and only use it to read your balances. You can disconnect it anytime, and also delete it in Binance.
binance_reconnect_body: Binance no longer accepts the key (you may have deleted it or changed its permissions). Create a new read-only key and paste it below. What was imported stays in your portfolio, without updates.
binance_skipped_other: Also not imported: {assets} (very small balances or no price).
binance_estimated_cost: We couldn't find your {tickers} purchases on Binance (maybe you bought them in another pair or transferred them): we used the price at import time as the purchase price.
binance_disconnect_title: What should we do with the imported holdings?
binance_disconnect_body: We delete the key from our server. Your imported holdings can stay as manual positions or be deleted.
binance_detail_partial_note: Some purchases are updated from Binance
binance_error_write: This key can trade, withdraw or transfer. Create a read-only one (only "Enable Reading") and try again.
binance_error_no_read: The key doesn't have read permission. Turn on "Enable Reading" in Binance.
binance_error_invalid_key: Binance didn't accept the key. Check that the key and secret are complete and that it has no IP restriction.
binance_error_plan: Connecting Binance is a Premium feature.
binance_error_region: Binance isn't available from our server right now. Try again later.
binance_error_rate: Binance asked us to wait a bit. Try again in a few minutes.
binance_error_busy: It's already updating. Wait a few seconds.
binance_error_network: We couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
binance_error_unavailable: We couldn't reach Binance right now. Try again in a while.
binance_connected_body: I bring in your crypto and keep it up to date on its own. I only read your balances: I never trade, withdraw or move anything.
binance_point_read_only_body: I use a key that can only read balances. If it can trade or withdraw, I reject it.
binance_point_sync_body: Your crypto shows up in your portfolio and updates without you doing anything.
binance_point_disconnect_body: I delete the key from our server and you decide what to do with what was imported.
binance_locked_note: Connecting Binance is a Premium feature.
